direction: Promote packet_scout_handoff_root as the champion family.
rationale: It is the narrowest concept that directly targets the saved H1 claim without collapsing into generic startup or generic multi-input extraction.
first_step: Implement a modular netlist with packet probes, storage capacitor, and delayed handoff gate.
expected_signal: Higher startup-success rate than fixed-path startup in mixed-polarity and high-impedance asymmetry cases.

direction: Keep dual_bucket_polarity_split_bootstrap as the first fallback variant.
rationale: It handles the clearest differentiator versus recent multi-input piezo papers: polarity-safe startup rather than collaborative extraction.
first_step: Model separate startup buckets and a merge clamp, then compare merge overhead to the root concept.
expected_signal: Lower back-drive loss in mixed-polarity cases at the cost of slower handoff.

direction: Use time_constant_ranked_arbiter as the low-complexity comparator.
rationale: It is the cleanest ablation target for source awareness because it can be removed or simplified without changing the main power path.
first_step: Build matched fast/slow RC sniffers and compare against a non-aware OR-ing startup baseline.
expected_signal: Better source selection in 1:5 and 1:20 impedance cases with modest control-energy overhead.
